intended_role: Independent externally published experimental movement/recapture geometry of a marked terrestrial amphibian, to examine source-anchor ambiguity in a geographic-only MRR test. NOT natural colonization, not 3-axis EOG-Pareto, not prospective EOG-WF endpoint.

source.measured_original_unit: UTM-style Easting/Northing coordinate values interpreted in meters ONLY if archived distance columns numerically corroborate those coordinate computations.
source.source_download_guard: Re-use exactly pinned host/url and read limits from validation/independent_movement_source_gate_v2/protocol_v2.json, no unrestricted redirect allowed.

data_contract.sample_unit: individual Toad ID (not raw row); equal weights across distinct IDs. All eligible fully coordinate-resolved events within each ID contribute equally to that ID mean.
data_contract.selection: all original 165 rows; report count with complete numeric initial, released, final coordinate pairs; requiring nonempty Date of re-encounter; reject duplicate rows only if byte-identical, otherwise retain and cluster by ID.
data_contract.geometry: Euclidean planar distances in stored Easting/Northing units: d_IR=||initial-release||; d_RF=||release-final||; d_IF=||initial-final||.
data_contract.relocated: d_IR >=90 meters (below smallest nominal 100-meter treatment, predeclared before reading values)
data_contract.sham_undisplaced: d_IR <=5 meters; descriptive control only (absence acceptable)
data_contract.intermediate: 5<d_IR<90 meters, report separately, never silently assign
data_contract.numeric_consistency_tol: max(2 meters, 0.05*computed Euclidean distance) for each supplied distance column, and at least 95% of rows with nonmissing published distances must match; otherwise STOP_GEO_UNIT_CONCORDANCE.
data_contract.date_policy: Date of re-encounter must be nonempty for eligible target. No elapsed-time model or posthoc date parsing required; do not equate observation-date precision with true movement onset.

inferential_targets.true_post_manipulation_source: the experimentally measured release position R
inferential_targets.counterfactual_wrong_source: the earlier capture position I (historical location, not most recent release)
inferential_targets.signed_directional_contrast: Delta=d_RF-d_IF, positive if known release-to-recapture distance exceeds historical capture-to-recapture distance.
inferential_targets.normalized_signed_contrast: Delta/max(d_IR,1 meter), by triangle inequality within [-1,1] for positive displacement
inferential_targets.threshold_table: For relocated eligible events, report count release_valid=(d_RF<=r), historical_source_valid=(d_IF<=r), possible=(min<=r), robust=(max<=r), false_assurance_under_historical_source=(d_IF<=r<d_RF), converse=(d_RF<=r<d_IF), all grouped by ID.

primary_prediction.direction: For eligible relocated individuals, equal-individual-weighted mean Delta >0, consistent with published toad homing descriptions. If <=0, retain refuted result.
primary_prediction.scientific_scope: post-publication cross-system source-definition diagnostic, NOT a novel discovery of toad homing and NOT a causal EOG model comparison.

secondary.readout: proportions of relocated individuals with Delta positive/zero/negative; median signed Delta; exact geometric source-ambiguity width; counts across fixed 100/250/500m gates
secondary.claim: descriptive; source-robust >= source-possible and triangle inequality are tautologies, not new biological findings.

negative_control.readout: for sham non-translocated <=5m source-choice gap should <=5m by triangle inequality; check only if sham present.

strict_stop_rules: If CSV SHA256, size or 165 original row count differs, STOP before analysis; do not update frozen source identity.
If fewer than 20 eligible relocated individuals or too much coordinate/distance mismatch, report STOP not a favorable/negative ecological result.
Use every eligible re-encounter row; do not select toads by displacement direction or sign.
When multiple rows share ID, equal-weight individual mean; do not count events as independent individuals.
Report missingness, retention, duplicates and independent IDs before any sign conclusion.
Do not fit a dispersal kernel, infer historical founding, causally attribute environment/barrier mechanism, or treat animal recapture as population colonization.
Do not change existing EOG-WF 3/31/3 closed denominator or previously frozen Glanville outcomes.
No raw Toad ID, coordinates, dates, original CSV or per-individual movement values committed/uploaded; output only population aggregates.
